notes.title: Descent of the Hunted to release on 2/23/24 as part of the Women's Day sale
notes.content:
Hello!
The QA phase (in preparation for release) for Descent of the Hunted is well underway, so I'm right on track. This game has been an interesting departure from Veil of Dust (our previous game) in that it focuses 100% on story. Since that's what we consistently heard was the favorite element of VoD, it makes a lot of sense to do a story game. ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2661040/Descent_of_the_Hunted/]Link here[/url])

The other obvious difference is the genre, although I think horror and VN fans will be a little more primed for the seriousness of the themes than Farm Sim audiences might have been, lol. In any case, I have had my hands full with our new baby and haven't done any promotion, so I hope this game manages to reach players despite that. If you liked VoD, Wishlist Descent of the Hunted, then purchase and review it as close to the release as possible! Reviews help Steam recognize new games as legit. 

Both Veil of Dust and Descent of the Hunted will be part of the Women's Day Sale coming up at the end of the month. Each highlight and explore different women's experiences in storylines straight from the quill of a female writer, as it were, so I'm confident they'll be great additions. My co-creator for Veil of Dust has also noticed that there's something fundamentally different about our female character designs, noting that they've been totally free of pressures external to the female creator's intentions. That's something special you can only get from tiny, independent teams.

Thanks for reading!
-Elle

notes.title: Veil of Dust: Full Game V1 coming Late March/ Early April
notes.content:
Hello Dusty Pals/ Dust-ites/ Dust heads, 

We're finally rounding the bend on having all our story content implemented with the remaining 4 romance arcs added, and thus, a [b]full version 1![/b] (Insert trumpet sounds) It's been a colossal project for two people, but we're proud of what we've done, and I, personally, feel good about putting a host of love stories into the world that are healthy, dynamic, and written entirely by a woman. So rarely do we see relationships in games depicted with realistic complexity, but I think that's what makes them feel like a real connection. I'm excited to hear what players think (so don't forget to leave a review, it helps with visibility and we're so tiny, we can use all the help we can get!)

As with our early access releases, you can expect a tested release that's been lovingly QA'd by yours truly, so don't feel you have to wait for updates to play. They will be a little slower to come from this point on, but we'll still be tuned in and committed to delivering a crash-free experience. 

Thanks so much for following our labor of love and we hope it means as much to you as it does to us.
-Elle

notes.title: Our Dec 11th release will bring us to around 2/3 of the complete game!
notes.content:
[b]Our next big release is coming up fast! [/b]
As the last post mentions, this release implements Shane as a playable character and realizes our vision of the Fantasy/ History experience split - Shane's adventures focus a lot more on the town of La Grande and its inhabitants, who embody the experiences of the people who lived in that time and place, warts and all.

Just as a reminder: You will not be able to access old save files once this release pushes, so finish up anything you want to do now, or don't install the update until you have. This is the message you'll see if you have old files: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40270494/cf08acd352fe83db46f63765e2b8f23fabd669b7.png[/img]

[b]What are the next steps for Veil of Dust? [/b]
Well, in a single word, content. We're going to focus on implementing the remaining 4 romance arcs (Nina, Clara, Arthur and Alysse), which will bring us to the full game as we've envisioned it. After that, we may do some enhancements to features and things like that, but it kind of depend on what happens with sales - We know there's a lot of people that won't touch Early Access games (and I don't blame them - I've bought some EA games that were completely unfun and unplayable) so we're hoping there are some players waiting in the wings for when we leave EA that we'll see convert once that's released. At that point we'll assess how much more we want to commit - We're a two-person team and this is a big game, after all!

notes.title: Veil of Dust is honored to have been chosen for the Tiny Teams fest!
notes.content:
We're honored to announce that Veil of Dust: A Homesteading Game was chosen this year for the Tiny Teams fest - a showcase of exceptional games from small studios put on by Yogscast.

This festival is such a great opportunity because it captures the original spirit of Indie Gaming - small teams of people brimming with passion for their projects who have the leeway to experiment and bring fresh ideas to gaming. Bigger games and teams can make impressive technical lifts, but they also have numerous stakeholders and pressure that guide their creative processes. Sometimes not always for the better. I've always said of Veil of Dust that we truly have one thing a AAA studio can never bring players - a 100% woman-lead creative effort.

There will be a hub page up on steam through which steam users can discover upcoming games developed by small studios, with some Tiny Teams alumni, such as Peglin and Escape Simulator, later going on to achieve great success. Many of the games will also be streamed on Yogscast's channel over the course of the festival. 

Veil of Dust will also be going on sale in celebration - If you've been waiting for a push, next week is your best bet until the next big release in November!

Hope to see you all there!
-Elle

notes.title: June 24 Fixes
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone for playing our game on the first day and submitting reports to us! For all of the number of hours players have put in so far, we're happy to only have seen a handful of items submitted.

The latest build includes the following fixes:

1. Fixes a bug where standing on certain edges of the river-room tent can cause Aine's commentary to run on repeat
2. Fixes a bug where hugging Shane on the edge of a screen can cause a crash
3. Fixes a bug where coordinates from an unfinished cutscene would cause Aine to walk off to unexpected places after subsequent cutscenes, frequently getting stuck
4. Fixes an issue where save files started on the Demo don't have the axe head when starting a new game
5. Fixes an edge-case bug where multiple cutscenes would attempt to run simultaneously, causing a crash
6. Fixes a bug where climbing at certain edges of the screen could cause Aine to get stuck climbing in place.

notes.title: Playtime estimate for Veil of Dust - 26-35 hours. We surpassed 1000 wishlists!
notes.content:
Just a brief announcement - We now have an estimated play time for the EA Build (26 - 35 hours for the main storyline content, the spouse storyline content, and obtaining all the available upgrades for the homestead). 26 hours would be for an ultra-optimizing player and 35 hours would be those who like to vibe a little more. Ultra-optimizers who play on Casual Mode may get through everything a little quicker than 26 hours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40270494/c07b23ec2df2ad03ff0c5e1e60b606fdc189b2fa.png[/img]

Other updates include more visual diversity in textures, a ton more features and quality-of-life updates, and obviously the storyline content. 

We also surpassed 1000 wishlists at some point in the past! Hooray! This is important because it tells steam that people are anticipating the game and it prioritizes it higher in the algorithm and shows it to more players who might be interested. Thank you for your support and we look forward to finally sharing our vision in the June 23rd release of Veil of Dust: A Homesteading Game!

-Elle

notes.title: The Veil of Dust: A Homesteading Game demo launching Tuesday- 2-3 hours gameplay
notes.content:
Veil of Dust: A Homesteading Game's public demo is set to be released next week on October 12, 2021. Players can expect 2-3 hours of gameplay surviving in the historical deserts of the Oregon frontier. [b][i]Fans of crafting, exploration and quippy writing with underlying depth will especially find a lot to like[/i][/b] in this charmingly hand-crafted farm sim, developed by a husband-and-wife team over the past year. Mechanics include [b][i]crafting, farming, foraging, hunting, fighting and more[/i][/b].

 https://youtu.be/WdE7OgEFtyc

Áine and Shane Callahan, the game's protagonists, are second-generation Irish-American siblings dropped by circumstance into the unforgiving deserts of the 1860's frontier after a catastrophic journey over the Oregon Trail. Join them as they navigate the challenges of building a homestead in such a sparse environment and as they journey beyond the veil to discover a world of magic, fae kingdoms, and dangerous monsters. 

[b][i]Casual Mode[/i][/b] will be accessible to those new to management and survival mechanics, or those who are looking to engage more in the crafting and story aspects. [b][i]Moderate Mode[/i][/b] is for experienced survival game players who are looking for more of a challenge. 

Interested players should wishlist and can join the [url=https://discord.gg/yUpEeFCKTb]discord community[/url] to help guide the development of the game by providing feedback or join the mailing list for updates right in their inbox. Streamers who would like to request an early-access key can contact the developers here (Your youtube page will be reviewed prior to key distribution). The press kit can be found [url=https://www.dropbox.com/s/kkbsvinrit51w8d/Veil_of_Dust_press_kit.pdf?dl=0]here[/url].

notes.title: Beta Testing for the demo opening today! Farm, Fight, and Forage to survive!
notes.content:
[b] Get a Key! [/b]
Beta Testing for the demo is opening today! We're looking to get feedback on game balance and the overall "fun factor". To get a key, join our discord here: https://discord.gg/yUpEeFCKTb and post that you'd be interested in testing. This test will run for ~10 days (and keys may be retracted at that point).

Not sure yet? Check out our Live Steam Highlight Reel here: 
[previewyoutube=6r1QFgVukgM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Game Description:[/b]

A story-driven, historically-grounded Farm Sim exploring life after loss. Survive in a sparse landscape and find new meaning through your adventures. Make peace with the past and forge a new future by building relationships, creating a new home, and discovering a world beyond the veil.

[b]Features:[/b]

Farm, Forage, & Hunt to Survive
Living in the desert isn't easy, but the magical abilities that force the protagonists to isolate themselves also helps them make the most of the environment. Farm, forage, and hunt to scrape by in the sparse desert of Eastern Oregon.

Unravel a Mystery
Guide Shane and Áine through the twists and turns of their search for answers about the monster attacks that threaten their fragile livelihood. Where will this undertaking lead these unlikely adventurers?

Forge Relationships
Survival isn't just about finding food and shelter. It's also about making life worth living. The support and attention of loved ones, romantic and otherwise, will bolster your spirit and give you strength.

Fight & Prevail
A homesteader isn't usually well-equipped for armed struggle, but desperate times call for desperate measures. Stand shoulder-to-shoulder with your sibling to defend your homestead against magical monsters.

Cook & Craft
Frontier cuisine is more about filling bellies than making an impression - scrape together what you can to conquer scarcity. Overcome challenges with tools and handicrafts that you create.
